surface_mechanism_description: The chemisorption of the precursors depends on the type of the functional groups on the surface during ALD. The chemisorption of a second precursor that follows the previous precursor is different from that after oxidant exposure. In particular, considering that TTIP and TMA did not react with each other, the change in film composition by modification of the process sequence can be understood as follows: The incorporation of Al ions per TMA exposure in process sequence 2 should be identical to those in process sequence 1 because the reaction surface immediately before TMA exposure is the same in both processes. In process sequence 2, TTIP exposure immediately after TMA exposure cannot contribute to film growth because TTIP barely reacts with the ligand of TMA. The O3 step, which was immediately after TMA in process sequence 1, was excluded in sequence 2. Therefore, O3 exposure after the TTIP exposure actually works on the preadsorbed TMA. The same ALD reaction of the Ti–O layer as that of sequence 1 was regained afterward.
